entries.title: Psalms 113:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 113:2
segments: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 113:3
segments: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah's name is to be praised.

entries.title: Psalms 113:4
segments: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 113:5
segments: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,

entries.title: Psalms 113:6
segments: That humbleth himself  to behold [The things that are] in heaven and in the earth?

entries.title: Psalms 113:7
segments: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;

entries.title: Psalms 113:8
segments: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 113:9
segments: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [And to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.
